text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon is delighted to hear about Manhattan Cafe's decision to compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems as if the Yayoi Sho holds great importance to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But Manhattan Cafe's only goal is to get closer to her friend, who exists far beyond Agnes Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe looks exhausted from the sheer effort she's been putting in… She's ready to give this race all she's got.
